slides.title: Meadow-style decks without manual layout
columns: Tell Claude what the deck is about and attach the copy or the brief. The skill splits the content into slides, lays them out on the grid and hands back a PPTX that opens in Keynote, PowerPoint and Google Slides.
Colours, type, spacing and imagery are built in, so every deck looks like ours: dark canvas, one lime plate, Geist and Syne.
